project.name: Re-derived Job Fixture
project.description:
Sprint 28f Stage 8 D5. Jawata-owned fixture for `re_derived_job`: two populations of methods that do ONE job each, written independently, plus the three negative controls the detector's four conditions exist for.
It is a project of its OWN rather than more classes in simple-maven, and that is the control's doing rather than tidiness: the test asserts that the TOKEN detector names none of these, and simple-maven already carries clone groups of its own, so on that tree the claim could never be made about this fixture alone. It also keeps simple-maven's counted populations still, which this sprint's record says have been moved four times by fixtures written for something else.
